name: g77_anger_intimidate
purpose: G77 M03: Anger Point Tauros (p2 slot a) takes six Intimidate drops (battle start plus five switch-ins of Tauros/Staraptor on p1 slot b), reaching Attack -6. Turn 6: Farfetch'd (Leek) Night Slash is a guaranteed critical hit on Tauros, which gets +6 with -setboost, a change of 12. Tauros does not attack Farfetch'd on turn 6, so Night Slash is not preempted.
